title: A Clean Merge
description: Merge the completed search feature into main without introducing conflicts.

tasks.label: Merge the search feature into main
Clean up the merged feature branch

hints: The search feature is complete on feature/search. Switch to main before integrating the feature into the main history.
Once the feature has been merged into main, the feature branch is no longer needed and can be cleaned up.

intro.message: Sarah reviewed the search feature and says it's ready. Bring the feature branch into main so it's ready for the next deploy.

switchToMain.message: Good. You're on the branch that should receive the search feature.

mergeFeature.message: Nice. The search feature is now integrated into main.

cleanWorkingTree.message: Perfect. The repository is clean and ready for the next step.

success.message: Merged and confirmed. That search feature is officially part of main now.

failure.message: The search feature isn't fully integrated into main yet. Check the current branch, merge state, and repository history.
